samples.xml_description:
<module id="traffic_light">
    <description>A traffic light system with red, yellow, and green indicators, controlled by a pedestrian button.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset.</input>
        <input id="clk">Clock.</input>
        <input id="pass_request">Pedestrian request signal.</input>
        <output id="clock" width_description="[7:0]">Internal counter value.</output>
        <output id="red">Red light signal.</output>
        <output id="yellow">Yellow light signal.</output>
        <output id="green">Green light signal.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <enum id="idle">Idle state.</enum>
        <enum id="s1_red">State 1: Red light.</enum>
        <enum id="s2_yellow">State 2: Yellow light.</enum>
        <enum id="s3_green">State 3: Green light.</enum>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description>
        <always type="sequential_logic">
            <reg id="cnt" width_description="[7:0]" description="Internal counter for timing."/>
            <reg id="state" width_description="[1:0]" description="Current state of the traffic light controller."/>
            <reg id="p_red" description="Previous value of the red signal."/>
            <reg id="p_yellow" description="Previous value of the yellow signal."/>
            <reg id="p_green" description="Previous value of the green signal."/>

            // State transition logic
            always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
                if (!rst_n) begin
                    state <= idle;
                    cnt <= 8'd10;
                    p_red <= 1'b0;
                    p_yellow <= 1'b0;
                    p_green <= 1'b0;
                end else begin
                    case (state)
                        idle: begin
                            state <= s1_red;
                            cnt <= 8'd60;
                        end
                        s1_red: begin
                            if (cnt == 8'd0) begin
                                state <= s3_green;
                                cnt <= 8'd10;
                            end else begin
                                cnt <= cnt - 1;
                            end
                        end
                        s2_yellow: begin
                            if (cnt == 8'd0) begin
                                state <= s1_red;
                                cnt <= 8'd60;
                            end else begin
                                cnt <= cnt - 1;
                            end
                        end
                        s3_green: begin
                            if (cnt == 8'd0) begin
                                state <= s2_yellow;
                                cnt <= 8'd5;
                            end else begin
                                cnt <= cnt - 1;
                            end
                        end
                        default: state <= idle;
                    endcase
                end
            end

            // Counting logic
            always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
                if (!rst_n || pass_request && p_green) begin
                    cnt <= 8'd10;
                end else if (!p_green && p_green) begin
                    cnt <= 8'd60;
                end else if (!p_yellow && p_yellow) begin
                    cnt <= 8'd5;
                end else if (!p_red && p_red) begin
                    cnt <= 8'd10;
                end else begin
                    cnt <= cnt - 1;
                end
            end

            // Output logic
            always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
                if (!rst_n) begin
                    red <= 1'b0;
                    yellow <= 1'b0;
                    green <= 1'b0;
                end else begin
                    red <= p_red;
                    yellow <= p_yellow;
                    green <= p_green;
                end
            end
        </always>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>The traffic light controller transitions between states based on the internal counter and the pedestrian request signal. The outputs are updated accordingly.</implementation>
</module>
